title: Amaranthium (Gimmickry)
description: Amaranthium (Gimmickry) is all about, certain weapon sets. This mod adds Mint, Mint Lollies, Marbles, and two end ores, Gravital Ore, and Invisite Ore, which looks exactly like endstone...
body:
Amaranthium (Gimmickry) adds a couple of armour and weapon sets, including a new netherite scrap-based alloy, the "Nethreal Ingot", which is made of 4 netherite scraps, 1 iron ingot, 1 copper ingot, 1 gold ingot, and 1 nether quartz.
the some armours added include the following:
- Mint Helmet
- Mint Chestplate
- Mint Leggings
- Mint Boots
- Stick Helmet
- Stick Chestplate
- Stick Leggings
- Stick Boots
- Marbled Helmet
- Marbled Chestplate
- Marbled Leggings
- Marbled Boots
- Paper Helmet
- Paper Chestplate
- Paper Leggings
- Paper Boots
- Bottled Helmet
- Bottled Chestplate
- Bottled Leggings
- Bottled Boots

There are also a couple of weapons, included in the following:
- THE STWIRCKD
- The Mintear
- The Marball
- Paper Sword
- Bottled Sword

there are some unique interactions between certain pieces of armour, and weapons.
these are "Bottled" which'll get a boost in Water/Lava, and "Paper" gear, which'll be weakened in water.


Please enjoy.
I recomend using JEI
